description:
The Opportunity 
The Euna Grants development team builds and supports the applications across the Euna Grants suite of products, working closely with product and sales teams in an Agile environment based on the Scaled Agile Framework. As a Software Developer , you will design, build, and test software, own the quality of everything you ship, and use AI coding tools like Claude Code in your daily workflow. If you want to own your code from design through production and grow your skills in AI-assisted development, this is the role for you.

 


 What You'll Do 

 
 Design, implement, and test software applications across multiple product offerings in the Euna Grants suite.

 Own the quality and correctness of the code you ship, whether you hand-write it or an agent produces it.

 Use AI and agentic coding tools to assist in design, implementation, and testing, and escalate tooling or agent-output issues promptly.

 Support and troubleshoot existing software in production.

 Present new code design and implementation patterns, and potential enhancements to the existing codebase, to peers for review.

 Demo newly developed features to relevant stakeholders.

 Mentor junior developers on related technologies and methodologies, and contribute to technical documentation.

 
 


 What You Bring 

 
 You have 3+ years of .NET experience with a focus on web development.

 You have 3+ years of professional experience with the ASP.NET MVC Framework and/or implementing and supporting RESTful APIs and WebAPI in ASP.NET C#.

 You have 1+ years of software development experience on AI-integrated applications, including implementing AI solutions in business environments using agentic frameworks.

 You have 1+ years of experience supporting RESTful APIs and tool integrations for LLM-based systems.

 You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

 
 


 Nice-to-Have Qualifications 

 
 Strong understanding of full stack development, including front-end experience with HTML5, SCSS, JavaScript, Knockout, TypeScript, and React.

 1+ years of professional experience supporting one or more SaaS products in a production environment.

 Working understanding of prompt design, basic knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), and some exposure to Claude-powered agents or similar LLM systems, even in a learning or non-production capacity.

 Ability to work autonomously and clearly describe what an AI agent did and what may need to change.

 




 


 Location 
This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our Oakville, ON office.



 


 Compensation Range: $94,200 - $117,700 
We believe in openness, so we publish our range from the start. Where an offer will land depends on your background, strengths, and how you'll contribute to the work ahead.


 This role fills an existing vacancy. Euna uses AI responsibly to assist in screening, assessing, or selecting applicants. AI helps us work smarter, but people lead the process.


 


 AI Mindset at Euna Solutions 
We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.

 If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.



 


 Life at Euna Solutions 
We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

 Here's what that actually looks like:


 


 🏢 How we work 
We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.



 


 🧘 Eunafier Days 
Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good work — not a reward for it. Use it however you need.



 


 🙌 Community is part of who we are 
Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.



 


 🤝 Philanthropy Time 
We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.



 


 🎉 Real connection at scale 
You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.



 


 📈 Room to grow 
Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.




 


 About Euna Solutions 
Euna Solutions® is the leading provider of purpose-built, cloud-based software designed to streamline procurement, budgeting, payments, and grants management for public sector and government organizations. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. Euna's full-cycle financial suite supports more than 3,600 organizations across North America in building trust, enabling transparency, and driving positive community impact. Recognized on Government Technology's GovTech 100 list, Euna Solutions is committed to advancing public sector innovation. To learn more, visit www.eunasolutions.com . Euna's privacy policy is available here .

 Please visit our website: https://eunasolutions.com/careers/ and check out our LinkedIn Pages https://www.linkedin.com/company/eunasolutions/ 

 


 We believe in embracing new perspectives and optimizing impact. If you have relatable experience and relevant transferable skills but feel you may be missing a few of the requirements, we encourage you to apply! We recognize that people have unique career journeys and if you're excited about this role and know you can bring something great to the team, then we want to hear from you. Please know Euna Solutions is committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview process for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

 


 For any inquiries or requests regarding accessibility at Euna Solutions, please email  recruiting@eunasolutions.com or call our office at 1.877.707.7755. Upon request, appropriate accessible formats or arrangements will be provided as soon as practicable.
